gemini_attempt.partial_response_cautions: Partial response asserted role distinctions without source verification and mentioned YouTube Stories. Do not accept this fragment as completed research or adopt its unsupported algorithm/demographic claims.

pilot_hypothesis.photos: One strong portrait/artwork post plus one carousel of real shoot photos. Individual photos, crops and thumbnails are supporting deliverables, not extra unique posts.
pilot_hypothesis.buffer: Before campaign A starts, main video B must be edited, QC reviewed and Nitin-approved; B campaign assets prepared, C ready to record. Full campaign B readiness is a stronger proposed target, not implied approval.
pilot_hypothesis.test: Two-cover feasibility pilot; do not claim causal winner from two songs. Measure actual production hours, rework, video retention/completion, shares/saves, meaningful reactions, new followers and buffer stability. Compare within platform and format at matched observation windows; label low-data cases.
pilot_hypothesis.cadence: Compare 2, 3 and 6 week release intervals against production capacity. Six-week promotional tail can overlap the next cover; distinguish campaign duration from release interval.
pilot_hypothesis.hours: Unmeasured; obtain factory estimates and record actual pilot time; no invented productivity claims.
